dashboard.noProgress: Finish a practice session to start the trend.
dashboard.noNotes: Record some notes to surface your patterns.
dashboard.avoidedHint: Intervals furthest from your usual patterns.

session.failed: Something went wrong with this take.

delete.hint: This permanently removes your account, notes, and audio. This cannot be undone.
delete.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and all of your notes. This cannot be undone.

analysis.windowMsHint: A take that changes chord quickly, where one chord is read across two.
analysis.minConfidenceHint: A wandering or bluesy melody, where chords are guessed that you did not imply.

engine.frameSizeHint: Very short notes, or fast runs — smaller catches them, larger steadies long held notes.
engine.hopSizeHint: Quick ornaments and grace notes, where the pitch moves between readings.
engine.minFrequencyHint: Singing at the very bottom of your range, where low notes go undetected.
engine.maxFrequencyHint: Whistling, or a high falsetto — most whistling sits above the usual ceiling.
engine.clarityThresholdHint: Which pitch is heard when a note is ambiguous — lower it and octaves start being read wrong. Not the one for notes going missing.
engine.emitRateHint: Watching the live pitch line while you sing — how smoothly it moves.
engine.voicedClarityMinHint: Whistling, or singing softly in a quiet room, where notes are missed rather than wrong. Lower it to hear fainter notes.
engine.voicedLevelDbHint: Recording somewhere with a hum or hiss, where silence comes back as notes. Raise it to ignore more of the quiet.

segment.vibratoSemitonesHint: Singing with a wide vibrato, where one held note comes back as several different ones.
segment.pitchHoldMsHint: Sliding between notes, where the pitches you pass through on the way turn up as notes of their own.
segment.maxGapMsHint: A long held note breaking into pieces, where the detector loses your pitch for a moment mid-note.
segment.articulationDropDbHint: Fast repeated notes on one pitch — "da da da da" — coming back as one long note instead of several short ones.
segment.aspirationRiseDbHint: Repeated notes pushed on the breath — "ha ha ha" — where nothing goes silent between them and they read as one note.
segment.onsetWindowMsHint: A note that swells as you sing it being split in two, or a soft re-attack not being noticed at all.
segment.minDurationMsHint: Very fast runs, where the quickest notes go missing — or clicks and breaths turning up as notes.

outOfTime.title: Time's up
